post.description: Audit Hub (docs/adr/0012): a right password answers a challenge, mfa: verify (POST /api/auth/mfa/verify with a code) or, for an account without a second factor yet, mfa: enroll (POST /api/auth/mfa/enroll, then enroll/confirm). The session (an access token, and the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie: __Host-refresh_token on Path=/ in production, refresh_token scoped to /api/auth elsewhere) starts there; a session this browser already had ends then. 403: the password is right, but the account may not use the panel (a member, or an auditor or a viewer without an application: docs/security.md#who-may-sign-in); no second factor is asked.

info.title: project-template-audit API
info.description: REST API under /api. Every response body is { data, message }; errors carry data: null. Authenticated routes take the access token from POST /api/auth/sign-in as a bearer token; the refresh token is an httpOnly cookie. Machine-to-machine routes (/api/ingest/, /api/connector/) take a request signed with a connected application's key instead (auditSignature, docs/adr/0006).

auditSignature.name: Audit-Signature
auditSignature.description: v1=<base64url HMAC-SHA256> over method, path, query, Audit-Timestamp, Audit-Nonce, Audit-Key-Id and Audit-Body-Digest (packages/audit-contract, signing.ts)
